ns2:group.ns2:description:
零跑汽车成立十年来，在中国新势力车企中一直是一个独特的存在。跟其他厂商不一样，他们一直非常低调。 2021年下半年，零跑汽车突然杀进了新势力销售榜的前五名，才开始被大家关注。 2025年3月拿到新势力月销量榜第一名之后，零跑在过去的十几个月里，只有一次是月销榜的第三名，其他月份全都是销量冠军，而且公司对外仍然非常低调。 这样的成绩，这样的风格，零跑到底是怎么做到的？创始人又是一个什么样的企业家？

ns0:entry.ns0:title: [Todoist]How Our Design Team Uses Todoist's Board Layout

ns2:group.ns2:title: How Our Design Team Uses Todoist's Board Layout
ns2:group.ns2:description:
Probably not surprising: we use Todoist for our work at Todoist. What might surprise you? We're not gatekeeping how. 😎
Heather and her team manage every brand request in one project: Brand Heroes. Anyone who needs something from the design team knows exactly where to go.
A few things from this setup worth stealing:
→ The Board layout: this clearly shows where every request sits across the team (in progress, awaiting feedback, done, etc.)
→ Task templates: this ensures teammates submit requests in the same format every time, so nothing arrives missing half the info the team needs
→The Weekly forecast column: this gives Heather insight into what's coming up and bandwidth
Try some of these tips for yourself!

ns2:group.ns2:description:
The best ideas never arrive on schedule. They show up in the shower, right as you're drifting off, or mid-commute when you definitely can't write anything down.
Naomi has been writing the Todoist newsletter for several years, and her best ideas for it spring up at the most random of times—not necessarily at her desk. She explains why here.

ns0:entry.ns0:title: [Todoist]Todoist's ChatGPT App is Now Live!

ns2:group.ns2:title: Todoist's ChatGPT App is Now Live!
ns2:group.ns2:description:
Todoist’s ChatGPT app is now live! A few things worth trying right now:
💬 Ask it to look at your Todoist Inbox and pull out five things you could realistically finish today. Then ask it to rewrite the vague ones into actual next steps. ("Email re: project" becomes something you'll act on.)
💬 Ask it to sort your overdue tasks by project and tell you what to reschedule and what to skip.
💬 Ask it to build a new project with the sections you want, or move everything tagged "waiting" into a dedicated section with a follow-up task on each one. Time and open tabs saved.
Here’s how to connect: ChatGPT → Settings → Apps → search Todoist.
What's the first thing you're going to ask it?
Learn more about how to use it: https://bit.ly/3SoEqcu
